scope: Local uncommitted maintenance changes. Synthetic data only.

worksheet_issue_batch.fixture: core.test_performance.QueryBudgetTests, POST circle issues, hidden worksheets

xlsx.method: Fresh isolated Python processes, resource.ru_maxrss. Writer and solved-index measurement. Whole pipeline flock/job-directory checked with synthetic snapshot.
xlsx.cleanup: Normal completion and injected OSError left no XML or job directory. One shared .lock file is retained. Interrupted jobs older than 60 seconds are pruned on the next export.
xlsx.concurrency: Real second flock rejected before select_issues. HTTP 429 includes Retry-After.

limitations: Single local runs, elapsed times are indicative.
Process RSS excludes database and container memory.
XLSX maximum-shape benchmark uses synthetic snapshot, separate from full ORM tests.
PostgreSQL native concurrency and query execution were not run. PostgreSQL export SQL was compiled.
